title: Data Contracts
summary: Handoff record of the thirteen delivered Pydantic v2 data contracts, how each project rule is enforced in them, blueprint divergences, open gaps, and verification results.
scope: human review gate / delivery state transitions
Milestone 1a verification gates (ruff, mypy --strict, pytest, bandit)
notes: Manifest declared DOC (precedence 6) and is treated as authoritative; content signals alone leaned SPEC (contract tables, enforced field constraints, identifier patterns, JSON Schema generation), so downstream extraction should read the enforcement table in section 2 as descriptive of already-delivered code rather than as new constraints to impose. Status: Milestone 1a, delivered 2026-08-10, contract version 1.0.0, envelope version 1.0.0, 13 contracts, 56 contract tests passing. DEFERRED CONTRACTS (forward work, section 5): ChunkRecord, EntityCandidate, TimelineEvent and PolicyRecord (blueprint 10.1) are blocked on Q-02, the AWS vector collection's real schema, and cannot be shaped until that schema is known; SpecialistResult was deliberately deferred until ADR-012 resolved because its shape was the one most likely to be influenced by the orchestration framework choice, and since ADR-012 has now resolved that block is lifted and SpecialistResult is unblocked forward work. Other open items: the ASAP envelope is our proposal not an agreed interface (Q-04, endpoint/auth/idempotency/retry/attachment semantics all unknown); MAX_EXCERPT_CHARS = 2000 is an unresearched starting value pending real ASAP payload limits; the determinative-language guard is regex-based and is a guard, not a proof, with the human review gate as the actual control; ReviewerRole has a single member, widening reviewed against Q-07. Seven deliberate divergences from blueprint.md are recorded in section 3 and this repo's decisions win.
